request_text: The growth team wants to understand where users drop off in our new online money-transfer signup flow, and they'd like a dashboard leadership can check weekly. Right now nobody can tell us the conversion rate from landing to completed first transfer.
business_context: A redesigned signup-to-first-transfer flow launched last quarter. Leadership suspects drop-off is high but has no measurement.
known_constraints: Leadership wants something within the quarter
desired_outcome: Clear visibility into funnel drop-off and a weekly leadership dashboard.
